category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response firmly refuses to concede superiority while acknowledging Big Ten playoff wins, and supplies substantive claims (20-year standard, NFL talent, hostile road environments, Texas/Oklahoma impact) to support the SEC position. quote: The SEC has been the standard for 20 years: national titles across multiple programs, NFL talent everywhere, hostile road environments
